info.name: philips-ecommerce
info.description:
Philips e-commerce microservices (learning project). All requests go through the API gateway ({{gatewayUrl}}, default http://localhost:8080) except the Eureka request.

Usage:
1. Import this collection AND postman/local.postman_environment.json.
2. Select the "philips-ecommerce local" environment.
3. Run the "Checkout journey" folder with the Collection Runner (in order).

customerId is generated once (CUST-PM-<epoch ms>) if empty - clear it to start a fresh customer. Every checkout request generates a new Idempotency-Key except the explicit replay step. Payment is SIMULATED via cardToken: tok_visa (success), tok_declined (402), tok_timeout (503 after the 3s read timeout, later refunded), tok_error (503). Seed data: products 1 and 2 have plenty of stock, product 5 has 2 units, product 19 costs > 5000 EUR, product 20 is inactive.

exec: // 1 delivery + 3 retries with 1 s backoff, then the DLT listener stores the record: wait ~8 s.
const mine = pm.response.json().filter(function (e) { return e.messageKey === pm.environment.get("dltOrderNumber"); });
pm.test("dead-lettered notification events recorded for the DLT order", function () { pm.expect(mine.length).to.be.above(0); });
